browse.transfer.title: Mark as a transfer
browse.transfer.explain: Holt never moves money. A pair tells the app that you moved it at the bank, so neither side counts as income or spending. Pairing also marks the other side as a transfer. When the pair matches a move at the bank that is still to do, the app marks that move as done.

browse.transfer.notImportedHelp: The app keeps this as a transfer and looks for the other side when you next import.

browse.income.about: {name} is money in. Income pays for a month of the plan. For money back from a shop or a bill, mark it as a refund against a job instead.
browse.income.monthHelp: Money in usually funds the next month. A late contribution can fund the month it was meant for.
